title: Austin Permits Meat Sales from Out-of-Town Packers
summary:
*   The special meeting focused entirely on public health regulations related to meat and meat product sales within the city.
*   Austin approved permits for four Texas packing companies—Augue (San Antonio), City Packing (Fort Worth), Wright-Patterson, and Neuhoff Bros. (both Dallas)—to sell their products locally.
*   Each company's plant underwent inspection by Austin's City Health Officer to ensure compliance with local health ordinances, particularly for meat not under federal inspection.
*   All permits were granted unanimously, authorizing the companies to sell meat products under strict adherence to Austin's health and safety regulations.
